Third-party libraries used by the PDF Tools page (pdf-tools.html).
They are loaded on demand by js/utils.js, only when a tool needs them.

jspdf.umd.min.js    jsPDF 4.2.1     MIT          creates the PDF in "File to PDF"
pdf-lib.min.js      pdf-lib 1.17.1  MIT          merges PDFs in "Merge PDFs"
xlsx.full.min.js    SheetJS 0.18.5  Apache-2.0   reads Excel / ODS files (see xlsx.LICENSE)
jszip.min.js        JSZip 3.10.2    MIT or GPL-3 reads Word / PowerPoint files
